_readme: Copy to <repo>/.vzt/connections.json. This is the EXTERNAL side-effect registry —
the boundary FILES_IN_SCOPE draws inside the repo, drawn one axis out.
A ship unit or worker brief may name a connection id in CONNECTIONS_IN_SCOPE only if
it is registered here; `vzt-agent ship-check` exits non-zero otherwise. Declaring
nothing means no outbound calls at all — default-deny, not unrestricted.
This file is GIT-TRACKED and must never contain a credential. Name the env var that
holds it in credentialEnv. ship-check rejects a `token`/`secret`/`apiKey`/`key`/
Required per entry: id, service, mode, credentialEnv, allow (non-empty).
Delete this _readme key in a real registry.

connections.note: Test-mode keys only. A unit that needs live billing is not a unit — it is a human decision.
Read-only against the sandbox portal — no contact writes from an agent.
Live and outbound: reading delivery status is fine, sending mail is a human action. Narrow allow lists are the point.
